cases.summary: Semester fee of Rs 18500 paid at Sri Vaigai College of Engineering before withdrawal has not been refunded; register reference FEE/AICTE-DEMO-1001/2026 is still pending.
Withdrawal from Vaigai Engineering College on 12 July: the semester fee of Rs 18500 was not refunded although register reference FEE/AICTE-DEMO-1001/2026 was quoted in my letter.
Refund of the semester fee Rs 18500 at Sri Vaigai College of Engineering is pending against register reference FEE/AICTE-DEMO-1001/2026. Accounts section says the file is with the principal.

The hostel fee of Rs 9400 for the same semester at Sri Vaigai College of Engineering was charged twice, and the refund against the semester fee is still pending; hostel reference HOSTEL/AICTE-DEMO-1001/2026.
Double charge of the hostel fee Rs 9400 for the semester at Vaigai Engineering College is not adjusted and the pending refund carries hostel reference HOSTEL/AICTE-DEMO-1001/2026.
The physics laboratory equipment at Sri Vaigai College of Engineering has been out of order since the start of the semester and practical classes are being conducted without instruments.
